April 14

10 He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not. (John 1:10 KJV)

This is so amazing that Jesus, the Messiah, which the Jews had been looking for, was not even recognized by them when He came. Even though the Jews had studied the Word of God all their lives, and gone through all the rituals that God prescribed through Moses, they could not even recognize the Messiah when He came. They had been so corrupted by this world, and the powers thereof, that they could not see who Jesus was, even though he was fulfilling so many Old Testament scriptures. Jesus was just an ordinary looking man (Isaiah 53:2), and I guess the Jews were looking for the spectacular and not the ordinary. If they would have looked at what He did (John 10:37-38), instead of being jealous of His popularity with the people, they should have known who He was.

It may be hard to believe, but we are so much more blessed than the people in Jesus’ day, as we are not influenced by His human appearance, but can see Him spiritually through the Word of God. The people of Jesus day did not have the Holy Spirit, living in them, to help them to understand spiritual things (John 14:26), which makes all the difference in the world. They did not understand that the Messiah would come twice, and expected Him to save them from the Romans at that time. We are blessed, blessed, blessed – Thank you Lord.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
